infoLinks.content:
At Taverners Hill Light Rail Lift 2 between Parramatta Rd (south side) and the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
·                     Use the stairs, if able to
·                     Or use the lift opposite on Parramatta Road.
 
For urgent assistance:
·                     Use the Help Point if on the platform
·                     Or call 131 500
